title: Multiset k-wise independence
statement: Let $Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $n,k$ be nonnegative integers, and let $A$ assign to each element of $Omega$ a sign vector in ${\pm1}^n$. The multiset given by these vectors is called $k$-wise independent when the binary function associated with its sign-multiset density is low-degree Fourier-regular with parameters $0$ and $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ maps $Omega$ to sign vectors of length $n$
